script_text: Saturn squares your 10th House Monday — career tension demands strategic patience, not impulsive force that burns your credibility. Early week sees Mercury trine Uranus Tuesday, igniting breakthrough ideas in your 3rd House of communication, but Wednesday's Moon square Mars triggers unnecessary conflict in personal relationships that drain you. Thursday shifts everything: Venus enters your 7th House of partnerships, bringing a love reconnection with someone from your past who understands your vision. Weekend energy clears Friday's Neptune confusion, revealing hidden career opportunities Sunday when Sun opposes your 10th House of public status. Wednesday powers your communication — Mercury trines Uranus there, amplifying your voice to reach the right audience. Avoid Monday's Saturn square in your career sector; delay major decisions until clarity arrives Thursday. Uranus rules your 9th House of expansion — trust the unexpected turns that redirect your path forward. Follow for daily updates.
